content:
Mia: :rotating_light: seeing a spike in GPU attach failures in eu-central around 10:03 UTC, pods stuck in ContainerCreating with `AttachVolume` timeouts
ops-oncall: noticed, metrics show attach_error_count spiking from 0 to 120 in 5m
Leo: any nodenames? are these new nodes from the autoscaler?
Mia: mostly nodes in slice-euc1-gpu-a, many recent scale-ups. kubelet logs show `nvme: timeout` and `Failed to attach volume`
Ben: could be provider-side block device attach rate limiting. cost note: if we shift live traffic to eu-west it uses larger instances and spikes hourly spend — call it +~12% on inference costs if sustained
Maria: I'm ssh'ing into one failed node, grabbing `dmesg`. seeing repeated `nvme timeout` + kernel messages referencing the driver. attaching paste: ```dmesg | tail -n 40
[12345.678] nvme nvme0: I/O 0 QID 1 timeout, aborting
[12345.679] nvme nvme0: failed command status 0x1
```
ops-oncall: agree we should failover traffic before draining the fleet. can we do a weighted shift?
Leo: initiating weighted shift: `routectl shift --from euc1 --to euw1 --policy weighted --weights 30,70 --window 10m` (starting at 10:18 UTC)
deploy-bot: Canary routes updated: euc1->euw1 weights 30/70. Canary paused for 2m checks.
Mia: scaling replica fallback for models pinned to A100s might saturate eu-west; enabling reserve pool in eu-west by adding 4 prewarmed GPUs (slice-euw1-prewarm).
Ben: confirm reserve pools will add ~4k/hr — flagging finance for temporary overspend.
Maria: while shifting, I'll open ticket with vendor on kernel nvme driver. logs + node IDs: node-gtx-34, node-gtx-37, node-gtx-41 attached to ticket INFRA-1123
ops-runbooks: Proposal: add runbook step between "Identify attach errors" and "Drain" to check provider API attach-rate and kernel driver errors. Snippet to add:
```
- Check provider attach-rate: providerctl metrics attachment.rate{region="euc1"}
- If attach_rate > 50/min AND kernel nvme timeouts present: do not drain; instead activate weighted-shift and reserve-pool
```
Leo: +1. Also add a mitigation to prewarm GPUs in target region before shifting >50% traffic.
Mia: Action items:
1) ops-runbooks to add the new attach-timeout decision gate and prewarm guidance (owner: ops-runbooks, due EOD)
2) Maria to file vendor kernel/driver bug and update INFRA-1123 with workaround steps (owner: Maria, due 3h)
3) Leo to document cost impact table for weighted shifts vs full region failover (owner: Leo, due EOD)
4) Ben to notify finance and approve temporary reserve pool spend (owner: Ben, asap)
5) SRE to add an alert that links attach_error_count + kernel log fingerprint (owner: ops-oncall, due 24h)
ops-oncall: running post-incident check list now, will post remediation checklist when done
deploy-bot: Canary checks passed. Weights at 30/70 stable for 15m.
Maria: vendor acknowledged issue, recommended kernel patch roll forwarded to sys-image team. Patch ETA 36h, will consider backport.
Ben: Finance approved temporary capacity for 24h to stabilize traffic.
ops-runbooks: Updated draft pushed to `docs/runbooks/attach-failures.md` with your proposed steps. Please review: link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/attach-failures
Mia: thanks — leaving the thread for follow-ups. tagging owners in the docs PR. :white_check_mark:
